reuse_instructions: Trigger once through scripts/trigger_reusable_task.py against active Goal STEG-BROWSER-MANIFEST-INTR-INGRESS-EXECUTION-001 / COSV 40000100100000. Bind the exact declared manifest first. Supply the applicable already-registered/profile-derived StegVerse Node Receipt #1 through node_binding_ref; do not discover an external host or create a Node. The runner validates Receipt #1 with the existing StegOS validator, binds manifest_sha256 + node_id + interlock_id + registration_receipt_sha256 + Goal + COSV into the existing LeaseRequest state identity, reuses SovereignLocalEventRuntimeAdapter for EVENT_EPHEMERAL materialization, retains the resulting lease_id + runtime_id binding receipt, and carries the exact correlation into the A4 ingress packet whose payload hash and ingress-packet hash are verified by the existing organization-local receipt. No pre-existing online runtime, generic chat-session process host, external device, endpoint/receiver discovery stage, duplicate materializer, scheduler, dispatcher, credential path, or alternate receiver is permitted. Source or CI state must never be promoted to runtime completion evidence.
